data.title: Tesla Stock Faces 3 Tests as China Retail Sales Fall 66.1% | Gotrade
data.summary: Gotrade News - Tesla (TSLA) faces three challenges bigger than its Roadster hype, The Motley Fool wrote on Nov. 22. Its domestic sales in China fell 66.1% year over year in October, its legal exposure remains unsettled, and the Cybercab must still prove its robotaxi economics, each a test for Tesla stock. [...] The article notes that Tesla "has never had trouble building hype or excitement for its business," and points instead to competition from China, courtroom costs and the business case for its robotaxi. In its view, how the company handles those three issues will decide how much of its promise reaches shareholders.
